name: Parallel Volume Rendering with Local Ray Tracing and Parallel Compositing
aliases: Parallel Volume Rendering with Local Raytracing
definition: A parallel volume rendering algorithm that distributes both volume data and computation to individual processing units (processors or workstations) to render high-resolution data sets. It consists of two phases: local ray tracing of distributed subvolumes without inter-processor communication, followed by parallel compositing of subimages in a determined depth order.
summary: Parallel Volume Rendering with Local Ray Tracing and Parallel Compositing is a data-space subdivision algorithm that distributes volume data and computation to nodes for independent local ray tracing, then composites subimages via binary-swap to solve scalability in distributed-memory environments.
